question: What is the strongest product direction hiding in LoopThing right now?

nodes.thesis: LoopThing is a compressed reasoning artifact for multiplayer AI work.
nodes.critique: Needs proof that compression reliably finds the gold; without that it collapses.
nodes.regenerated: Start as a compression test and thin CLI before format, viewer, or SaaS.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing becomes a semantic decision layer over git-like history.
nodes.critique: Strong category language but too abstract for v1.
nodes.regenerated: Use as strategic north star after compression-first handoff works.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing helps users retrieve prior thinking for themselves.
nodes.critique: Labs can ship memory with better integration; second-brain behavior has weak return loops.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing wins as a beautiful viewer and rich portable file.
nodes.critique: Can make weak compression look impressive; infrastructure before proof is theater.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing creates a corpus useful for RL or model training.
nodes.critique: Tiny customer set, slow B2B path, and labs have richer native signal.
nodes.kill_reason: Possible downstream asset, not initial wedge.

nodes.thesis: Compression-first handoff may fail if handoff is rare, compression is unreliable, or recipients only want conclusions.
nodes.critique: The direction survives only if it becomes testable immediately.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing v1 is a compression test harness before it is a format product.
nodes.critique: Unsexy but highest leverage; proves or kills the wedge before infrastructure.
nodes.regenerated: Run 20 chats through three compression variants and score creator faithfulness plus recipient comprehension.

nodes.thesis: The next loop is empirical: run the protocol and update the product direction.
nodes.regenerated: Use LOOP_04_TEST_PROTOCOL.md as the gate for CLI, viewer, and format work.

nodes.thesis: The first persona is AI-native technical founders and product builders.
nodes.critique: Potentially too close to the creator, but fastest source of real chats and handoff pressure.
nodes.regenerated: Run the first test on founder/builder chats with real cofounder or teammate recipients.

nodes.critique: Plain markdown may feel too small, but this keeps the compression test honest.
nodes.regenerated: Treat the .loopthing container as the seal step after reasoning.md proves useful.

nodes.thesis: The first product is a local CLI compression harness.
nodes.critique: Developer-heavy, but aligned with the initial wedge and avoids premature platform work.
nodes.regenerated: Build compress, score, compare, and seal commands only after the manual compression test shows signal.

nodes.thesis: Distribution starts as a private compression challenge.
nodes.critique: Small audience, but high-signal and behavior-based.
nodes.regenerated: Use anonymized before/after artifacts and a thesis post only after test results exist.

nodes.thesis: The next 30 days prove or kill the compression-first handoff thesis.
nodes.regenerated: Collect chats, score artifacts, build the thin CLI only after signal, then publish proof.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing should be a high-trust reasoning company, not an AI dashboard or services wrapper.
nodes.critique: Compression-first is strong but incomplete without brand trust, revenue progression, life-design constraints, and an operating system.
nodes.regenerated: Create loops/company with area PRDs, progress logs, artifacts, and a runner for business, finance, marketing, design, website, product, and life-design loops.

nodes.thesis: LoopThing now has a local product v0: transcript files in, compressed reasoning artifact out.
nodes.critique: The compressor is still heuristic, so the next loop must improve scoring and real-export importers.
nodes.regenerated: Ship compress, score, compare, and seal commands as the first real product slice.

nodes.thesis: Normal users should run one command: create.
nodes.critique: The four-command flow is useful plumbing but bad product shape.
nodes.regenerated: Add `loopthing create` as the happy path and preserve advanced commands for inspection.

nodes.thesis: The compressor should privilege explicit reasoning sections over flat keyword matches.
nodes.critique: Keyword-only extraction made the project-folder output plausible but too dumb.
nodes.regenerated: Parse markdown sections and extract killed paths, risks, asks, and next action from their own sections first.

nodes.thesis: Real AI projects are mixed chat-plus-artifact corpuses, so source shape must be part of the artifact.
nodes.critique: Folder-only compression lets generated docs drown out the live user directions that moved the project.
nodes.regenerated: Classify source kinds, render source shape and recent user directions, and reserve critical-message slots for chat user turns.

nodes.thesis: The most valuable compressed artifact is paste-ready context for the next agent or collaborator.
nodes.critique: A reasoning artifact can still become another document unless it helps a fresh session continue the work.
nodes.regenerated: Emit `agent-handoff.md` on every run with product spine, source shape, recent user directions, killed branches, risks, asks, next action, and operating instruction.
